title: Sensitivity or Criterion? Measuring and Moving When Language Models Act
abstract: arXiv:2610.15415v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Before an agent acts, it must decide whether action is warranted. A single accuracy cannot distinguish failure to recognize a warranted action from reluctance to act. Signal-detection theory separates sensitivity from criterion, but criteria estimated from authored binary labels depend on each benchmark's example mix. We introduce FlipAct, a diagnostic of tool use in physical states. A rule over annotated tool properties computes each answer and a graded evidence score, fixing the Yes/No boundary at zero across models. Questions form 2-by-2 quads that hold required knowledge fixed while the state flips. The slope of the fitted Yes-rate curve measures sensitivity; its crossing at one half measures criterion. Across 44 open models, sensitivity rises with size within a family, and its ranking agrees with three of four external when-to-act benchmarks. translated_title: 敏感性还是判定标准？测量并改变语言模型的行动时机
translated_abstract: 在智能体行动之前，它必须判断是否需要采取行动。单一的准确率指标无法区分“未能识别出应采取的行动”与“不愿采取行动”这两种失败。信号检测论将敏感性（sensitivity）与判定标准（criterion）分离开来，但从人工标注的二分类标签中估计出的判定标准依赖于各基准的样本构成。我们提出FlipAct，一个针对物理状态下工具使用的诊断方法。基于标注工具属性的规则计算每个答案及分级证据分数，并将“是/否”边界在所有模型中统一固定为零。问题构成2×2的四元组，在保持所需知识不变的同时翻转状态。拟合的“是”率曲线的斜率衡量敏感性；曲线过半处的交叉点衡量判定标准。在44个开源模型上，敏感性随同家族模型规模的增大而上升，且其排名与四个外部“何时行动”基准中的三个一致。模型对证据的符号而非大小作出反应，接受那些……（原文截断）
tldr: 提出FlipAct诊断框架，基于信号检测论将语言模型“何时行动”的决策分解为敏感性与判定标准两个独立维度，发现敏感性随模型规模提升且与外部基准高度一致，而模型仅依据证据符号而非大小来决定是否行动。
en_tdlr: FlipAct is introduced as a signal-detection-based diagnostic that separates sensitivity from criterion in language models' when-to-act decisions, revealing that sensitivity improves with scale and models respond to evidence sign rather than magnitude.
